question: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) 2025 reduced the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) by 25 basis points with immediate effect to ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.0 per cent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) in 2025 reduced the **policy repo rate** under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) by 25 basis points to **6.0 per cent**.
 
• Repo rate is the interest rate at which the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) lends money to commercial banks to meet their short-term funding requirements.
 
• This reduction is often aimed at encouraging borrowing and investment to stimulate economic growth.
 
• Changes in the repo rate are a key monetary policy tool used by the RBI to control inflation and ensure liquidity in the market.
 
• The decision of the MPC is influenced by prevailing economic conditions such as inflation, GDP growth, and global financial trends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC):**

 
 
• The MPC is a statutory body constituted under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, to decide the policy interest rates.
 
• It consists of six members: three from the RBI and three external members appointed by the Government of India.
 
• The MPC meets bi-monthly to review and set the repo rate based on inflation and other economic indicators.
 
 
 
• **Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF):**
 
 
• LAF is a monetary policy tool that allows banks to borrow money through repurchase agreements.
 
• It consists of repo and reverse repo operations to regulate liquidity and short-term interest rates in the economy.
 
 
 
• **Inflation Targeting:**
 
 
• The RBI's primary mandate is to keep inflation within the target range set by the Government of India.
 
• As of recent guidelines, the inflation target is 4% with a tolerance band of ±2%.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Repo Rate Changes:**
 
 
• A reduction in repo rate lowers borrowing costs for businesses and individuals, boosting economic activity.
 
• An increase in repo rate helps curb inflation but may slow down economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Current Economic Trends:**
 
 
• Global financial conditions, geopolitical tensions, and domestic inflation trends often influence MPC decisions.
 
• The repo rate decision is a balance between supporting growth and ensuring price stability.
